 How a 1982 Bengali disco song from Kolkata made it to GTA 6
 The standout track is from Kolkata singer Rupa Biswas' album Disco Jazz. The song was composed by Ustad Aashish Khan, the Grammy-nominated sarod maestro and grandson of legendary musician Ustad Allauddin Khan 
 Moneycontrol News 
 November 20, 2026 / 17:23 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 rephatse
GTA 6 generates $2.36 billion (Rs 21,952 crore) in its first 24 hours, selling 24.58 million copies, with PlayStation accounting for the bulk of sales 
 A Bengali disco song released in 1982 has found an unexpected new audience, more than four decades after its release, thanks to its inclusion in the global radio playlist of video game Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6). 
 Titled Aaj Shanibaar (Today is Saturday), the track by Kolkata singer Rupa Biswas features on Worldwide FM, one of the in-game radio stations in GTA 6. The song has caught the attention of Indian gamers exploring the game's fictional setting of Leonida, with its appearance prompting discussions on social media. 
 Who composed the song? 
 Released in 1982, Aaj Shanibar (Today is Saturday) is the standout track from Kolkata singer Rupa Biswas' album Disco Jazz . The song was composed by Ustad Aashish Khan , the Grammy-nominated sarod maestro and grandson of legendary musician Ustad Allauddin Khan, along with his wife Firoza Khan, who contributed to the composition and lyrics. 
 Indian song found on GTA 6 Radio
 "Aaj Shanibaar" by Rupa Biswas (1982) https://t.co/DcwgHVPLbO — The GTA Assassin (@thegtaassassin) November 19, 2026 
 Aashish Khan also produced the album and played the sarod on the track, while his brother Pranesh Khan played the tabla. Blending disco and funk rhythms with Indian classical influences, the song features Bengali and Hindi lyrics and has a distinctive sound built around the interplay of electronic instruments and traditional Indian music. 
 Its appearance in GTA 6 has brought renewed attention to a relatively lesser-known chapter of India's disco era. The 1980s saw disco become a major part of Indian popular culture, with tracks such as Nazia Hassan's Aap Jaisa Koi from Qurbani (1980) and the music of Mithun Chakraborty's Disco Dancer (1982) becoming hugely popular. 
 While Aaj Shanibaar has long had a following among vintage disco enthusiasts and music collectors, its inclusion in the game has introduced the Bengali track to a much wider international audience. 
 GTA 6, released on November 19, marks the franchise's return to Vice City after more than 13 years. Its in-game radio stations feature music spanning several genres and cultures, with the inclusion of Biswas' Bengali track emerging as one of the game's unexpected musical highlights.
